{{Quote|We are presently one hundred six light-years past the border of the New Republic, in the Core. The nearest inhabited system is Prakith.|[[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]]|<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
The '''Prakith Minor system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also known simply as '''Prakith system''',<ref name="SoL" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Coordinates zero-nine-one, zero-six-six, zero-five-two. Uncertainty due to measuring error, two percent.''"<br />"''Triple zeroes? That can't be right. That would put us in Sector One.|[[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
The Prakith Minor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jason Fry revealed during the development of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] that the Prakith Minor system was created to clear up confusion from [[Galactic coordinates|system coordinates]] mentioned in ''[[Shield of Lies]]'',<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref> incorrectly placing the Prakith system in [[Imperial Center Oversector|Sector One]].<ref name="SoL" />
